import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Existing assessment attempt binding details
binding = {
    "assessment": "Final Exam",
    "course": "CS101",
    "student_name": "Alice Johnson",
    "student_id": "S12345",
    "attempt": "Attempt 1",
    "bound_at": datetime(2026, 10, 11).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
    "status": "Bound"
}

# Bind the rubric and objective versions
binding["rubric_version"] = "v2.3"
binding["objective_version"] = "v1.0"

binding_df = pd.DataFrame(list(binding.items()), columns=["Field", "Value"])
print("Updated Binding Details:")
print(binding_df.to_string(index=False))

binding_df
